import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = 499122177

def solve(n, m, l, r):
    cells = n * m
    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(pow(r - l + 1, cells, MOD))
        return
    even = r // 2 - (l - 1) // 2
    odd = (r - l + 1) - even
    ans = (pow(even + odd, cells, MOD) + pow(even - odd, cells, MOD)) % MOD
    ans = ans * INV2 % MOD
    print(ans)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    solve(n, m, l, r)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
